title: VacationResponse/set upsert is not atomic — TOCTOU race
description: vacation.rs handle_vacation_set:161-209 implements upsert as: update -> if NotFound -> create -> update. Two concurrent requests can both see NotFound, both call create_object, and the second create may produce a duplicate or error without the first update being applied. The backend is Send+Sync so concurrent calls are possible. Fix: the backend should expose an upsert primitive, or the handler should document that it assumes single-threaded access and that real backends must handle idempotent create.
